text: The customer wants to speak directly with a manager because their smart plug (Order LM-47720) damaged their extension board and their previous calls went unanswered. So far, the agent collected the order number, offered a ₹500 apology coupon (which the customer declined), and flagged the issue for the duty manager. Next, the duty manager needs to call the customer within 24 hours.
